definitions.sql: CREATE INDEX invoice_open_amount ON billing.invoices USING btree (billing.net(total)) WHERE paid < total

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION billing.invoice_total(bigint, bigint)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
RETURN (SELECT billing.net(i.total) AS net FROM billing.invoices i WHERE ((i.tenant_id = $1) AND (i.id = $2)))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION billing.net(numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
RETURN round($1, 2)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION billing.net(integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
RETURN $1

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE reporting.close_run(IN bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO reporting.checkpoints(run_id, finished_at) VALUES ($1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
END;
$procedure$

SELECT tenant_id,
    id,
    billing.invoice_total(tenant_id, id) AS amount
   FROM billing.invoices i
  WHERE balance > 0::numeric;

SELECT tenant_id,
    sum(amount) AS outstanding
   FROM reporting.open_invoices
  GROUP BY tenant_id;
